steps.intro: The same six places. Стало или становится? Say the verb in the right form — the Russian tells you which — then tap to check.

p: Since they renovated the old buildings, the square
(становится) — more and more people are coming to the market.

steps.note: стала + -er → has gotten (BrE: has got) — or: has become · становится (ещё идёт) → it's getting (or: it's been getting) · ничуть не изменилась → hasn't changed at all · 's = has or is: it's gotten = it has gotten, it's getting = it is getting.

steps.intro: The shopping street. Стало или становится?
steps.note: стала + adjective → has become (or: has gotten) · становится → it's getting (or: it's been getting) · изменилось → has changed.

steps.intro: No Russian now. Look at the picture and the words around the gap: has the change already happened, or is it still happening?

p: Over the last ten years, the area

steps.note: over the last ten years + it has happened → has become (or: has gotten) · still happening: are going up (строятся), is getting worse every year (or: has been getting worse) · hasn't changed at all.

steps.intro: The harbor. Happened, or still happening?

p: Over the last few years, the harbor

p.b: more and more touristy every summer

p: (not change) — it's pretty much the same.

steps.note: over the last few years + it has happened → has gotten (BrE: has got) · still happening: it's getting more and more touristy, prices are getting higher and higher (or: have been getting)

steps.instr: Less help now. Say two things that have changed and one that is still changing. Then tap to see one way to say it.
steps.sit: [The elevated highway and the canal.] Still changing: more and more people are coming here every weekend.
steps.ans: It's **gotten a lot greener**, and it's **become much quieter**. And it's **getting more and more popular**: every weekend there are more people walking along the water.
steps.note: happened: it's gotten / it's become (or: it's completely changed) · still happening: it's getting more and more … (or: it's been getting)

steps.instr: No help now. Two things that have changed, one that is still changing. Then tap to check.
steps.sit: [The warehouses and the skyscrapers.] Still changing: there are more people here every year.
steps.ans: **It's completely changed.** It's **gotten a lot more built-up**, and it's **become much fancier**. And it's still **getting busier and busier** — there are more people every year.
steps.note: happened: it's changed / gotten / become · still happening: it's getting busier and busier (or: it's been getting busier).
